court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Ventura
case_search_note: Criminal or Traffic Case Inquiries go through the court's Online Public Access (OPA) site, linked from the Case Inquiry page; the Criminal/Traffic page says to use OPA for misdemeanor/felony hearing information. Use of the site means accepting the court's Terms of Use; it is not the official record.

courthouses.name: Hall of Justice (Ventura)
courthouses.hours: Building Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; Criminal/Traffic lobby (filing) Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; walk-up payment windows Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; phones 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
courthouses.note: Cases served: Appeals, Civil, Criminal, Domestic Violence, Family Law, Small Claims, Traffic. Main criminal courthouse; in the Government Center with the Pre-Trial Detention Facility. Records division is here.

courthouses.name: East County Courthouse (Simi Valley)
courthouses.hours: Building Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; Traffic Division and payment windows open Monday and Tuesday only, 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; phones Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
courthouses.note: Cases served: Criminal, Small Claims, Traffic.

courthouses.name: Juvenile Justice Center (Oxnard)
courthouses.note: Cases served: Juvenile Delinquency and Dependency, Probate/Conservatorships/Guardianships, Small Claims, Traffic incl. adult and juvenile traffic trials, Adoption, Civil Harassment ROs. Adult criminal (misdemeanor/felony) not listed — criminal flag is for traffic trials only.

legal_aid.name: Ventura PD — Fresh Start (record clearance)
legal_aid.what: PD program for expungements, record sealing and early probation termination. As of 2026-10-13 the page says it cannot accept new applications because of court case-management changes ('check back in 30 days'). The PD also lists an Expungement Clinic and outreach events; call and ask for the Fresh Start Team.

programs.name: Adult Drug Court
programs.summary: For drug offenders who failed Deferred Entry of Judgment and would otherwise go to state prison; non-violent drug felonies and non-violent non-drug felonies driven by drug abuse. Assessment, outpatient/residential treatment, counseling, intensive probation and random testing.

programs.name: Mental Health Court
programs.summary: Post-booking, out-of-custody formal-probation program for adults with a primary mental illness and co-occurring substance disorder, booked for misdemeanors or low-level felonies. Treatment, medication monitoring, therapy, intensive probation, crisis services, housing/employment links.

programs.name: Veterans Court (VCVIP)
programs.summary: For honorably discharged veterans with combat-related psychological injury or substance abuse charged with jailable offenses; requires a guilty/no contest plea; completing the treatment plan earns a reduced sentence. VA staff in court.

programs.name: Community Intervention Court
programs.summary: For homeless people arrested for repeated vagrancy-related municipal code violations in the City of Ventura; treatment and case management instead of fines/jail. Excludes violence, drug sales, mandatory-jail offenses.

programs.name: Domestic Violence Court
programs.summary: Single judge monitors DV offenders' enrollment in a 52-week program and probation meetings.

programs.name: Elder Law Court
programs.summary: Dedicated calendar for Penal Code 368 elder abuse cases (except trials and prelims).

programs.name: Homeless Court
programs.summary: Lets homeless people resolve fines for minor violations through community service; sessions held at homeless advocacy sites.

programs.name: Stand Down Court
programs.summary: Court session every July at the veterans Stand Down event to resolve infractions and minor misdemeanors for homeless veterans.

programs.name: Before criminal court
programs.summary: Court: if represented by the Public Defender, contact your assigned attorney for instructions BEFORE coming to court; check OPA for misdemeanor/felony hearing info; if you can't afford a lawyer, contact the Public Defender.

bail.note: Ventura Sheriff: bail may be posted at the Pre-Trial Detention Facility (800 S. Victoria Ave., Ventura) by cashier's check payable to Ventura County Superior Court, or by credit/debit card online via GovPayNet or by phone 1-888-604-7888 (PLC # 6404). East County Jail also accepts bail bonds and deposits 24 hours. Verify any bail agent's license with the CA Department of Insurance.
